```plato

//==
// # Sparse and banded matrices
//
// Matrices whose storage is proportional to their non-zero content rather than
// to their shape: coordinate-list sparse storage and the banded form of a
// matrix whose non-zeros hug the diagonal. The dense counterparts (and the
// IMatrix interface) are the section above; these types deliberately
// do not claim IMatrix, because element access is a search rather than an
// offset.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices (row-vector multiplication,
// v' = v M); rows and columns here mean the same thing they do there.

// One stored element of a sparse matrix: its zero-based position and value.
// Entries are unordered and a position may repeat; the value at a position is
// the sum of the entries that name it, which is what makes concatenation a
// correct sum.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparse_matrix#Coordinate_list_(COO))
type SparseMatrixEntry
    implements IValue
{
    Row: Integer;
    Column: Integer;
    Value: Number;
}
```
